deploy.startCommand: sh -c 'if [ "$RAILWAY_SERVICE_NAME" = "celery-worker" ]; then celery -A app.celery_app worker --loglevel=info --concurrency=2 --max-tasks-per-child=1000; elif [ "$RAILWAY_SERVICE_NAME" = "celery-beat" ]; then celery -A app.celery_app beat --loglevel=info; else python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8000}; fi'
